archive_kind: Explicit top-level summary projection, not the complete original result

negative_controls.probe_identity: Forced binary probes must have BA=.5 on identical opposite-label inputs.

data.inference: Three paired frozen-model/data blocks;20000 whole-block bootstrap resamples,seed4001900001;pointwise unadjusted95% intervals across27 prespecified primary contrasts. Exploratory, not confirmatory.
data.probe_definition: Nominal FIT256 only, mean squared error to +/-1 with ridge alpha .1; train-only standardization, std<1e-8 columns zeroed in all conditions; unpenalized intercept. Scores within1e-10 of zero are forced to label0, otherwise score>0 predicts1.
data.null_scope: FIT-label shuffles refit twenty nuisance readouts and evaluate true TEST labels. TEST-label shuffles keep true-fit scores and permute TEST labels. Values are descriptive controls, not adjusted p-values or proof of absence/presence of information.
data.claim_boundary: Linear accessibility in frozen post-step states does not establish native causal use, changed native performance, general retrieval, or delay-dependent storage. The fixed cue-position/opposite-candidate task is already logically answerable at t10. Extra history dimensions are reported explicitly.
